verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly reference building funnels, segmenting users, and answering 'why' via charts/dashboards, which is core to this story, but there is no direct documentation detail on breakdown/filter mechanics within a funnel, nor independent hands-on validation of funnel accuracy — one community comment even flags data accuracy concerns during implementation. missing for 10: explicit funnel filter/breakdown feature documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of funnel drop-off analysis working as described.
